producer_notes: Call graph read from the compiler's own IR. Direct edges are the callee operand and are correct by construction. Indirect call sites (callee in a register) are resolved by matching the site's type signature against address-taken functions -- a candidate set, not an answer, so those edges are labelled and excluded from call_depth.

timings.command: docker run --rm -e FUZZING_ENGINE=libfuzzer -e SANITIZER=address -e ARCHITECTURE=x86_64 -e FUZZING_LANGUAGE=c -e HELPER=True -e SANITIZER_FLAGS=-flto -g -fno-inline-functions -fuse-ld=gold -Wno-unused-command-line-argument -e AR=llvm-ar -e NM=llvm-nm -e RANLIB=llvm-ranlib -v /home/ze/fb-graphs/build/sq-full-01/repo-bitcode:/src/sqlite3 -v /home/ze/fb-graphs/build/sq-full-01/out:/out -v /home/ze/fb-graphs/build/sq-full-01/work:/work aixcc-afc/sqlite3:latest bash -c compile 2>&1 | tail -40; mkdir -p /out/bc
